prompts.prompt: A coherent professional art prototype set for a cozy 2D pixel-art tavern management browser game titled THE MOONLIT TANKARD. Strict orthographic top-down / classic 2D RPG front-facing furniture, NEVER isometric, NEVER 3D. Crisp deliberate square pixel clusters, retro 16-bit craft, no smooth painterly shading, no blur, no photographic texture. Palette: midnight navy #182535, charcoal ink #151923, dark walnut #352A28, warm oak #895638, amber #D99B45, parchment #E9D7AC, sage #7F9373, muted brick #A35445, moonlight #8BA9BC. Warm intimate light. Beautiful polished production art-direction board, generous frame, exact legible short English headings, no watermark. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape master floor-plan art board. One large complete overhead roofless tavern rectangular floor plan occupying 85% of the board, with subtle fine square planning grid, cozy living game scene rather than blueprint. Ground floor indicative layout for 32 columns x24 rows: upper left pantry/storage with shelves sacks and barrels; upper middle-right kitchen with stone oven copper pots and prep tables; extreme upper right small enclosed stairs down; counter across middle just above hall, shelves of green bottles behind it, opening to kitchen, a cash till. Large lower hall with six small round and rectangular dining tables in two lateral clusters and a clear central walkway leading from the south central double-door entrance up to bar. Left wall stone hearth, right wall moonlit windows. Four stools in front of bar; seats around all tables. North utility rooms separated by solid walls with visible door openings. Small bottom-right inset cellar floor plan with stone walls, wine casks and fermentation barrels. Outside tiny blue night courtyard and hanging crescent-and-tankard sign. Composition main map left 82%, clean slim legend right listing 01 HALL,02 BAR,03 KITCHEN,04 PANTRY,05 ENTRY,06 CELLAR with colored tiny marker squares; small matching numbered markers placed in regions, no excessive text. Title top THE MOONLIT TANKARD and subheading 01 / MASTER MAP. No UI screenshots. Readable circulation and functional zoning.
